digest.component_or_area: CI workflows - tickets repository partial clone optimization
propositions: Add filter: blob:none to all target actions/checkout@v7 steps and direct git fetch commands while preserving fetch-depth: 0, credentials, and ref settings

Implement production guards that parse size-pack from git count-objects -v and enforce REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 (standalone) and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 (Gerrit) limits after fetch and materialization

Establish real-Git E2E test fixture with git daemon, filter capability negotiation oracle, and protocol packet verification to prove blob:none transmission and missing-object behavior across named-origin and direct-URL fetch paths
Ensure standalone and Gerrit identity jobs leave git count-objects -v unchanged post-materialization, demonstrating no promisor-blob fetching during verify-identity execution

Achieve measured transfer-size reduction from full-history baseline (standalone 1.04 GiB / 59 s, Gerrit 6.73 minutes) to blobless (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s, 22 MB / 3.6 s post-fetch, 83 MB / 8.6 s post-materialization)
